# E03 行列式的性质

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E03Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("行列式的性质", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E03_1_1", "行列式是方阵对应的一个数。掌握行变换对它的影响，可以大幅简化计算。", "", tts_text="行列式是方阵对应的一个数。掌握行变换对它的影响，可以大幅简化计算。")
        line_1 = Text("行列式是数，不是矩阵", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E03_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E03_1_2", "交换两行，行列式变号；一行乘 k，行列式乘 k。", "", tts_text="交换两行，行列式变号；一行乘 k，行列式乘 k。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"R_i\leftrightarrow R_j:\ -D,\quad R_i\mapsto kR_i:\ kD", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E03_1_2")
        self.start_cue("E03_1_3", "一行加上另一行的倍数，行列式不变。", "", tts_text="一行加上另一行的倍数，行列式不变。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"R_i\mapsto R_i+kR_j:\ D\ (i\ne j)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_1_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E03_1_3")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E03Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("行列式的性质", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E03_2_1", "不要把初等行变换都当成不改变行列式。只有倍加这种变换保持行列式。", "", tts_text="不要把初等行变换都当成不改变行列式。只有倍加这种变换保持行列式。")
        line_1 = Text("交换：变号；倍乘：乘系数；倍加：不变", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E03_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E03_2_2", "若两行相同，交换它们后行列式不变又变号，所以行列式等于零。", "", tts_text="若两行相同，交换它们后行列式不变又变号，所以行列式等于零。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"D=-D\Rightarrow D=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E03_2_2")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E03Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("行列式的性质", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E03_3_1", "例题：利用倍加计算二阶行列式。", "", tts_text="例题：利用倍加计算二阶行列式。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"D=\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&7\end{vmatrix}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E03_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E03_3_2", "第二行减去第一行的三倍，行列式保持不变。", "", tts_text="第二行减去第一行的三倍，行列式保持不变。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"D=\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E03_3_2")
        self.start_cue("E03_3_3", "上三角行列式等于主对角线元素乘积，故结果为一。", "", tts_text="上三角行列式等于主对角线元素乘积，故结果为一。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"D=1\times1=1", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E03_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E03_3_3")
```

from manim import *
